organization.description: The organization whose name exactly matched the requested value.

who.description: UUID of the user that made the change

api.Audit.description: Audit records the person that updated the data last.

organizationId.description: Organization the connection was created for

entityId.description: Entity ID of the SAML IdP

signInEndpoint.description: Sign-in endpoint for the SAML IdP

signInCertificate.description: Sign-in certificate from the SAML IdP

isEnabled.description: Whether the connection is enabled or not

autoprovision.description:
Whether auto-provision is enabled or not
 (when on, users from the SAML IdP are automatically added to the organization during login)

strict.description:
Whether strict is enabled or not
 (when on, only email's with the connection's linked email-domain can be invited + forces everyone with linked email domains to use SAML login)

wantAssertionsSigned.description:
Whether this connection requires the identity provider to digitally sign SAML assertions before they are accepted.
 This is a standard and commonly supported setting in SAML identity providers. Enabled by default.

wantAssertionsEncrypted.description:
Whether this connection requires the identity provider to encrypt SAML assertions before they are accepted.
 This is preferable but not supported by all major identity providers. Disable if your IdP is Microsoft Entra ID or Google Workspace.

validateSignatures.description: Whether this connection validates signatures on incoming SAML responses.

source.description: Adding source attrribute to differentiate whether connection is migrated from UDS or already present in CBP, Ticket : CBP-13455

domainName.description: Name of the domain (example: cloudbees.com - what comes after the @ in an email address)

organizationId.description: Organization this email-domain record was created for

challenge.description: UUID used for verification of this email-domain record

isVerified.description: Whether the email-domain is already verified or not

connectionId.description: Connection id that this email-domain is linked to

teamId.description: team to which this email was invited

teamRole.description: role for this email when accepted into the team

isAutogenerated.description: if this invite was created based on a different invite

invitedBy.description: user ID of the user who created this invite

api.auth.Invite.description: Record of the invitation for a new user for an organization

type.description: what type is the login, see enum

password.description: for password logins, the encrypted password

isVerified.description:
whether the login method has been verified, some login methods are
 automatically verified

api.auth.Login.description: How a user logs in to the system

id.description:
ID here must match with the resource ID in resources table,
 since an organization is a type of resource.

displayName.description: Organization display name  -  not the same as the resource name

domainName.description:
Organization domain name  -  this must match with the resource name
 (since resource name could be in the URL, it must be URL-safe, that's why the domain)

isDisabled.description: if true, the organization is no longer active

parentId.description: parent id if this is a sub-organization

properties.description: key value pair of extra information to store in the organization object

teams.description: Teams that are part of the organization

displayName.description: Human-readable display name of the organization.

domainName.description: URL-safe domain name of the organization, used in API paths.

isDisabled.description: When true, the organization is no longer active.

childOrganizations.description: Sub-organizations that belong to this organization. Populated only when `nested` is true.

parentId.description: Unique identifier of the parent organization. Present only if this is a sub-organization.

description.description: Optional description providing additional context about the organization.

metadata.description: Deprecated: use the properties field instead.

audit.description: Audit metadata for the organization, including creation and last modification timestamps.

properties.description: Key-value pairs of additional metadata associated with the organization.

teams.description: Teams that belong to this organization.

emailDomains.description: Email domains associated with this organization.

connections.description: Identity provider connections configured for this organization.

isImplicit.description:
Populated when SkipDefaultReadAll is enabled for the tenant.
 When true, the user can see this organization name for breadcrumb
 navigation but does not have explicit read access to it. Implicit
 organizations cannot be selected in the organization selector widget.

organizationId.description: The organization the role belongs to

isDeleted.description:
IsDeleted indicates if this record is no longer valid
 Anyone assigned this role will no longer have the permissions granted by this role

isEditable.description:
Is the role editable. If not, the role can not be modified or deleted.
 This is useful for system roles that should not be modified Vs "custom" roles that can.
 Default is false.

api.auth.Role.description:
Roles are a collection of permission actions.
 PermissionActions can not be granted to a user
 directly, a role must be created.

isDefault.description: Indicates whether this is the default team for the organization. Every organization has exactly one default team, which automatically includes all members and cannot be deleted.

immutable.description: Indicates whether the team is managed by an SSO connection. When true, team membership and configuration cannot be modified manually.

organizationId.description: Unique identifier of the organization this team belongs to.

userIds.description: List of unique identifiers of users who are members of this team.

supportEnabled.description: Indicates whether this team is synced with Zendesk support.

metadata.description: Key-value pairs of additional information stored on the team object.

isDeleted.description: Indicates whether the team has been soft-deleted.

audit.description: Audit metadata including creation and last modification timestamps.

description.description: Optional description providing additional details about the team's purpose.

users.description: Full user objects for each member of this team, populated when users are included in the response.

type.description: The type of team. Valid values are PREDEFINED (system-created, cannot be deleted) or USERDEFINED (user-created, can be deleted).

organization.description: The organization this team belongs to, populated when organization details are included in the response.

invites.description: Pending invitations associated with this team.

familyname.description: family is the sur or "last" name

displayname.description: displayname is the preferred name to use in the UI

type.description: indicates the type of the user, could be a human, could be a machine

status.description: indicates the status of the user

loginIds.description:
logins are the specific login methods that user uses to authenticate
 with the system. See Login message.

preferences.description: Key value pair of preferences, things like font, theme, avatar url

associatedEmails.description: list of emails linked to this user; not used for login

api.auth.User.description:
User will live in a separate database from the rest of the
 platform due to PII

type.description: The type of entity being protected

api.auth.permission.Permission.description: Permission message represents a permission that can be granted to a user on an API entity.

@type.description: The type of the serialized message.

google.protobuf.Any.description: Contains an arbitrary serialized message along with a @type that describes the type of the serialized message.
